description:
Dermalogica Clarifying Body Spray: a blemish-fighting body spray with 1% salicylic acid for hard-to-reach areas like the back and chest.

• Blemish-fighting body spray for hard-to-reach areas like the back and chest (177 ml and 295 ml)
